profile.headline: Senior Full-Stack Engineer
profile.summary:
I’m a growth-focused software engineer passionate about building products that deliver real impact. At Postman, I ship AI-driven features for high-impact projects such as Agent Mode, redesign onboarding flows, and develop tools that increase engagement and accelerate user activation. My work blends hands-on engineering with data-driven experimentation and product strategy to drive measurable growth, boosting signups, reducing churn, and improving collaboration across teams.

Previously, at ZenBusiness, I led core website and platform microservices, scaling post-purchase products and improving customer retention through thoughtful architecture and user-focused design. I enjoy tackling complex systems, building tools that empower users, and translating technical vision into tangible business outcomes.

Please don't hesitate to reach out for anything, let's connect!

positions.title: Software Engineer (Growth Engineering)
positions.locationName: San Francisco, California, United States · Hybrid

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer (Website and Platform Growth)
positions.description:
• Owned the complete implementation of core microservices for the ZenBusiness Websites
platform, leveraging React/Node.js and Django frameworks to enhance scalability and
streamline product workflows with consequent 5% reduction in CAC payback and ~20%
YoY boost in customer retention through increased value of post-purchase add-ons.

• Crafted and deployed Avo/Rudderstack tracking across the platform’s entire website suite,
guaranteeing thorough data collection and analysis for informed decision-making.

• Designed and engineered a new automated onboarding process to empower customers
with new domain/email creation without assistance from support team, saving 200+
hours of manual input per week and reducing fulfillment time from 7.5 days to 1 hour.

• Directed a series of A/B testing campaigns via LaunchDarkly integration to introduce new
potential products such as a starter business kit, evaluating customer engagement and
driving an 8% increase in post-purchase revenue growth.

positions.title: Software Engineer II (Formations and Compliance)
positions.description:
• Led the development and successful debut of a formation tracker that allows customers to
monitor their progress and receive real-time updates during the order creation process.

• Streamlined the user process for stock filings by adding a new flow and integrating backend fee calculations tailored to state regulations, ensuring both accuracy and compliance.

• Released an internal tool that allowed for instant creation of test accounts in dev
environments through improved communication with pre-MFE core ZenAPI monolith,
saving ~20 hours of weekly development time and boosting sprint velocity.

• Played a key role in energizing project initiatives through fast-paced swarming of
outstanding epics, working closely with the team to boost productivity and regularly
contributing to 25-50% increase in biweekly story point completions.

• Employed comprehensive integration testing suites to uphold and guarantee high code
quality throughout core ZenBusiness services, resulting in more efficient and dependable
software releases.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineering Resident
positions.description: Mentoring students on modern full-stack web development technologies (React, Node.js/Express), data structures & algorithms, software design/architecture, and agile development

positions.title: Back-End Engineer - Adidas Service | Full-Stack Engineer | React, Neo4J, Express, AWS/EC2, Webpack
positions.description:
·  Managed Neo4J database with 50 million generated reviews and established relationships to users/products
·  Achieved optimized 30ms query retrieval runtimes leveraging loader.io and New Relic for load testing
·  Created multiple EC2 instances for sharded graph data clusters, proxy server, and client-side application

positions.title: Full-Stack Engineer - AudiGen | React, Node, MongoDB, Mongoose, axios, Spotify
positions.description:
·  Artist and Playlist Generator based on personal music interests
·  Designed clean and functional SPA UI to provide users with library customization and music playback using React components with conditional rendering, Styled Components, and Spotify Web Player SDK
·  Utilized MongoDB to give users the ability to cache user data, tokens, and past genre/artist searches 
·  Renders curated playlists with playable tracks and artist suggestions using Spotify’s Web API and axios

positions.title: Full-Stack Engineer - TripAdvisor | React, Express, MySQL, Webpack, axios, AWS/EC2
positions.description:
·  Leveraged Agile-based development approach with team to develop and manage the Q&A component of TripAdvisor attraction page using React
·  Stored user-submitted data using MySQL and established endpoints for users to retrieve subsets of questions and corresponding answers
·  Established multiple AWS EC2 instances for Proxy Server to render three individual microservices as one cohesive webpage

positions.title: Business Intelligence Data Analyst
positions.description:
- Developed/leveraged SQL queries, MS Access databases, and MS Excel templates to collaborate with Recognition teams in consistently boosting temp/perm sales performance by 15% annually and providing monthly and quarterly reports company-wide for the year-round Reach For The Stars sales competition, the most crucial driver for recruiter performance growth.
- Constructed ETL dataflows in the DOMO Business Cloud to accurately organize/transform various revenue data sent in from 75% of clients globally, enhance UI functionality and data accuracy for clients, and provide better reporting tools for my team.
- Built and presented data visualization dashboards in DOMO regarding staffing performance and business growth to various clients and internal teams company-wide.
- Utilized IBM Cognos Analytics and SQL queries to provide ad-hoc project requests and monthly/quarterly reports for clients globally.

positions.title: Data Analyst Intern
positions.description:
- Worked with Protiviti Finance to analyze 85% of all annual client data from reports and deliverables fed to the team by field officers across the US and determine how to best improve key variables such as project-based revenue. 
- Collaborated with senior finance directors to create a new Hyperion-based business data glossary that would capture all the relevant measures and operations that were used from iTrac by the entire Protiviti team. 
- Used Python scripts and VBA macros to enhance Protiviti Business Intelligence database by re-formatting clusters of client reports, clearing or moving directories depending on relevance, and organizing files that are specifically relevant to the team. 
- Helped write scripts for Business Intelligence team that would optimize and automate their daily work operations, such as a Windows PowerShell script that would take all files within a directory with a specific name and alter their names/content at once.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
-	Allocated funding to Principal Investigators (PIs) affiliated with the center by analyzing the center’s budget and issuing up to $75,000 in grants to PIs accordingly with guidance from the center’s director.
-	Submitted and published a final report to the US DOT with the center’s co-director for a Zero Emissions Vehicles conference in San Francisco, which covered new initiatives to seamlessly incorporate EVs.
-	Regularly utilized HTML to optimize the functionality of and update the UCCONNECT website.
-	Used R to write scripts that would contribute to the center’s co-director’s research on optimizing public transit routes in urban areas by calculating and minimizing dwell time differences (difference between arrival and departure times) for public transit operators in urban cities.
